items.headline: Frost Advisory issued May 24 at 2:12AM AKDT until May 24 at 7:00AM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Temperatures as low as 30 to 34 will result in frost
formation for the Upper Chilkat Valley.

* WHERE...Haines area north of 23 mile.

* WHEN...Until 7 AM AKDT this morning.

* IMPACTS...Frost could harm sensitive outdoor vegetation. Sensitive
outdoor plants may be killed if left uncovered.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Minimum temperatures in this area on Saturday
morning ranged from 29 to 33.
items.instruction:
Take steps now to protect tender plants from the cold. Sensitive
plants and shrubs should be covered or brought indoors if possible.
